[[File:ZaxSitsAROUNDTheCantina-KOTOR.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Zax]], owner of Zax's Bounty Office]]
'''Zax's bounty office''' was located in [[Javyar's Cantina]] in the [[Lower City]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Although the [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] posted at the bounty office were supposed to be government authorized, [[Davik Kang]] would often place unauthorized bounties regardless of what the laws said. These so-called "special bounties" were often favored by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] as they were less dangerous than standard, officially approved bounties. The office was run by a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] named [[Zax]].

Zax's bounty office was a place where many bounty hunters looked for work on Taris. Some visitors to the office were bounty hunters [[Calo Nord]] and [[Canderous Ordo]]. The bounty office was presumably destroyed when the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] bombed Taris in [[3956 BBY]].

==Known Bounties==
In 3956 BBY, shortly before the Sith bombing of Taris, the following bounties were posted at Zax's bounty office.

===Tarisian Government Bounties===
{{Main|Selven}}
[[File:Selven.jpg|thumb|left|100px|[[Selven]]]]
[[Selven]], a Tarisian [[Assassin/Legends|Assassin]].

{{Main|Gorse Bendak}}
[[File:BigBadBucketheadBendak-KOTOR.png|thumb|left|100px|Bendak Starkiller]]
[[Gorse Bendak|Bendak Starkiller]], an ex-[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] on Taris, where he accidentally killed a nobleman's daughter and then became a gladiator at the [[Taris dueling ring]].

===Exchange Bounties===
{{Main|Largo}}
[[File:Largo-KOTOR.jpg|thumb|left|100px|[[Largo]]]]
[[Largo]], a Tarisian merchant who owed Davik money.

{{Main|Matrik}}
[[File:Matrik-KOTOR.jpg|thumb|left|100px|[[Matrik]]]]
[[Matrik]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] and former member of the exchange who betrayed Davik.

{{Main|Dia}}
[[File:Dia-KOTOR.jpg|thumb|left|100px|[[Dia]]]]
[[Dia]], a female resident of the [[Upper City|Taris Upper City]] who struck an Exchange agent named [[Holdan]] with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|Vibroblade]] in self-defense.
